list.sTitle: New Honkai: Star Rail Merchandise Available on Amazon!
list.sIntro: The Gift+ Series "Firefly 1/8 Figure Spring Missive Ver." makes its grand debut! The Firefly figure carries a spring theme, capturing her lively demeanor and a dreamy atmosphere~
list.sContent:
The Gift+ Series "Firefly 1/8 Figure Spring Missive Ver." makes its grand debut! The Firefly figure carries a spring theme, capturing her lively demeanor and a dreamy atmosphere~

Also making its debut is the "Girls' Dorm Series" merchandise, featuring Firefly, Kafka, Robin, and Silver Wolf. This release spans a variety of items across the character portrait series and chibi series. Come experience their cozy daily dorm life together~

The "Character-Themed Impression Series" silk scarves for Aventurine • Waveflair and Sparxie have also hit the shelves, available in both square and long styles. So, come explore diverse and intricate outfit inspirations!

〓Promotion Period〓

2026/11/13 00:00:00 – 2026/11/23 23:59:59 (PST)

list.sTitle: A Moment Among the Stars — "All's Well That Ends Well" | Honkai: Star Rail
list.sIntro: All the universe is a stage,
list.sContent:
All the universe is a stage,

And everyone merely players.

They have their exits and their entrances.

And one in their time plays many parts.

Until the show ends, and then

An anticipated announcement is made:

The Elation never takes a curtain call!

list.sContent:
Dearest travelers from afar,

"Why not try starting a game once more? Savor the pain it brings once more, tremble at its cruelty once more, and wander through the hell within yourself once more. Do this over and over, and eventually, you'll get better at this game. Eventually, you'll learn to laugh."

Yours truly, the unwelcoming Aha
